**Overview:**  
Gemilang Harmoni Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company engaged in the retail of textiles and baju kurung, operating in Sarawak. It was incorporated on 21 October 1997 and was formerly known as Unity Industries Sdn. Bhd. until a name change on 3 September 2025. The company has three directors and a top shareholder holding 45.57 % of the issued share capital of RM 5,000,000. No legal cases are recorded against the firm. The firm is currently listed as Active with a share capital of RM 5,000,000.
